title: Known-object test, TOI-450.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-450.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* ≤2.5, —, 5, 7, —; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth none on grid, none on grid, none on grid, none on grid, none on grid (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit recovered (1 covered epoch). Residual screen: 147 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 5 light curve(s), forming 38 distinct event(s), 17 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines.
